Comments (English): [ Not as reliable as we had hoped, despite the brand ] || ---------------- || I'm unsure if this unit is defective or if it's a result of poor build quality from the manufacturer. We've encountered issues with the latch and seal on this unit a couple of times since purchasing it last July 2022. Despite having Geek Squad address the problems on a couple of occasions, they seem to reoccur every few months. Although we've just surpassed the one-year warranty period, we'll wait and see what the outcome is this time. The primary concern revolves around the door, which fails to maintain a secure lock. While we can get it to work by manually pressing and holding the door closed, we can't realistically dedicate three hours to keeping it shut. There's a small magnet near the latch that makes contact with the door and initiates the cycle. My suspicion is that this magnet isn't strong enough to ensure the necessary closure for the cycle to proceed. Additionally, the seals on the interior seem flimsier compared to older models, and I can audibly hear them releasing water pressure before abruptly stopping the cycle. Having a reliable dishwasher significantly simplifies life, but the stress caused by this particular unit has prompted me to question the overall quality of the brand. Sentence (English): After tolerating a GE Profile dishwasher for over 10 years, and multiple repairs, I was glad when it finally gave up the ghost.
Comments (English): [ Niiiice! ] || ---------------- || After tolerating a GE Profile dishwasher for over 10 years, and multiple repairs, I was glad when it finally gave up the ghost. I researched around 20 dishwashers for price, reviews and features, and finally settled on this one as the overall winner. It's looks didn't hurt either. The accent strip that runs across above the handle relieves the monotony of a slab of stainless. Now on to the good stuff:. + Cleaning: Cleans so good. + Drying: This is not so important to me but I tried it with the drying and extended drying functions anyway. Dishes felt warm and dry with both. For my own use, I turn drying off and keep the door partially open to let them air dry. + Cycle Time: About 2 hours 45 minutes for sensor wash with no drying. Drying adds about 40 minutes to this. There is a quick wash option that takes about an hour - Tried that and dishes came out just as clean. The installer told me it uses more water and power with the quick wash but that's to be expected. + Quiet: The silence is meditative. Also, if anyone else wondered about whether you can open this edge display dishwasher while it's running - Yes, you can. Just press start again before closing it up to let the cycle continue. Don't want to jinx it, but I am very pleased. Also, wanted to give a shoutout to Quality Kitchens, BestBuy's installer in the DC-MD-VA region. Thorough, detail oriented tech who took the time to explain the operation of the dishwasher to me and answered my questions in detail.

Sentence (English): After tolerating a GE Profile dishwasher for over 10 years, and multiple repairs, I was glad when it finally gave up the ghost.
Comments (English): [ Niiiice! ] || ---------------- || After tolerating a GE Profile dishwasher for over 10 years, and multiple repairs, I was glad when it finally gave up the ghost. I researched around 20 dishwashers for price, reviews and features, and finally settled on this one as the overall winner. It's looks didn't hurt either. The accent strip that runs across above the handle relieves the monotony of a slab of stainless. Now on to the good stuff:+ Cleaning: Cleans so good.+ Drying: This is not so important to me but I tried it with the drying and extended drying functions anyway. Dishes felt warm and dry with both. For my own use, I turn drying off and keep the door partially open to let them air dry.+ Cycle Time: About 2 hours 45 minutes for sensor wash with no drying. Drying adds about 40 minutes to this. There is a quick wash option that takes about an hour - Tried that and dishes came out just as clean. The installer told me it uses more water and power with the quick wash but that's to be expected. + Quiet: The silence is meditativeAlso, if anyone else wondered about whether you can open this edge display dishwasher while it's running - Yes, you can. Just press start again before closing it up to let the cycle continue. Don't want to jinx it, but I am very pleased.Also, wanted to give a shoutout to Quality Kitchens, BestBuy's installer in the DC-MD-VA region. Thorough, detail oriented tech who took the time to explain the operation of the dishwasher to me and answered my questions in detail.

Sentence (English): This replaced a GE Profile dishwasher that never cleaned dishes well from day one and needed a few repairs over the years.
Comments (English): [ Leaves my dishes clean! ] || ---------------- || This replaced a GE Profile dishwasher that never cleaned dishes well from day one and needed a few repairs over the years. I am so glad that it finally stopped working - Gave me the impetus to finally get rid of it and shop for a new dishwasher. After checking out features, reviews, and prices on probably around 20 products at HD, BB, and other retailers, I finally decided on this one as the overall winner on these attributes. It doesn't hurt that it looks great too. After using it for a few weeks, I am very pleased with its performance. Dishes are clean. Many people are very concerned about drying and overall wash time, so I'll talk a little more about its performance in these areas. I have tried the sensor wash cycle, without drying, with drying, and with extended dry times. There will still be some moisture and droplets after "drying" but "extended dry", leaves the dishes quite dry. I use it with drying turned off, and leave the door open to let my dishes air-dry. The sensor wash cycle with drying turned off takes a little under 3 hours to complete, and with drying it takes a little over 3 hours. There's also a speed cycle which takes about 1 hour - I was told by the tech that this uses more water and power but that's an understandable trade-off. Both, the sensor and the fast cycle leave dishes very clean. Some other highlights: + Love the third cutlery tray on top. + Capacity is awesome. + I can even place 8.5" Corelle salad plates in the middle shelf with dinner plates on the bottom shelf. + The filter is easy to remove and check. + Was very happy with the Best Buy installation (DC-MD-VA area). + Extended warranty - I'll probably go with Whirlpool (3-year 115, 5 year 169) + You only get the Whirlpool extended warranty offer after you register the dishwasher.

Sentence (English): This is the second countertop dishwasher in my family, so I have a lot to say.
Comments (English): This is the second countertop dishwasher in my family, so I have a lot to say. The first one is "Cuckoo" 3 years ago, a typical online celebrity brand, known as a dedicated dishwasher. After 3 years, because there is no after-sales service, the washing capacity can only be changed: this model is slightly larger than the previous one (3 sets of old labels, 5 sets of new labels) There are still many sets of this size, such as Midea). After using it for several years, I know that the low-utilization rate is uncomfortable, so when Dongxing is less, I wait for the next meal, and the problems caused by this are obvious. So size is very important. At present, this larger size is the appropriate logistics speed: it is a bit slow by JD.com’s standards. The order was placed on Monday and it was delivered on Thursday. I saw that the logistics is from Dongguan to Shenzhen, so there is no rush. After-sales service: I have to say more about this. I always worry about the installation is not good when I place an order. The master contacted me the next day after placing the order, because there was a baby at home who specifically requested to come after 4:30 pm, and the master fully cooperated. I was away on a business trip, and my daughter-in-law watched the master come to the door, punch holes, debug, and everything was fine when I got home. The original cuckoo was popular for a while, but there was basically no service. In the end, even the company could not be found. In the end, because of a small drainage problem, I could not find accessories and had to give up. Appearance: This kind of appearance is thinner, and the original one is chunky. The biggest shortcoming is that there is no progress time prompt, how long the process has been going on, and how long it will continue to be invisible. I'm a little sorry about the cleaning ability: I need to make comments on this. Although liquid and solid cleaners can be used, it's a pity that there is no function similar to a measuring cup for liquids.
Comments (Original): 台上洗碗机我家这是使用第二个了，所以想说的有点多。第一台是“布谷”3年前典型的网红牌子，号称专心洗碗机，3年后因为没有售后只能换了洗涤容量：这个型号略大于之前的（旧标3套，新标5套，这种尺寸的还是不少比如美的）用过几年深知低利用率开机内子的不爽，所以东兴较少的时候就等下一顿凑，这样来带的问题很明显。所以尺寸非常重要。目前看这个较大一点的尺寸是合适的物流速度：以京东标准有点慢了，周一下单，周四才送到，看了物流是东莞发深圳，到是不急。售后服务：这个就要多说了，下了单总是担心安装不好，师傅乱来，乱打孔，乱收费之类，结果是非常好！下单第二天师傅就联系了，因为家里有小宝宝特意要求下午4:30以后上门，师傅都全力配合。我出差在外地，媳妇看着师傅上门，打孔，调试，等我回家一切都不错。原来的布谷网红一时，却基本没有服务，最后连公司都找不到了，最终因为排水一点小问题找不到配件只能放弃。外形外观：这种属于较薄的外观，原来的是矮胖的。最大的不足是没有进度时间提示，流程开始到底进行了多久，接下来还有多久看不到。有点遗憾清洁能力：这个要提提意见，虽说液体，固体的清洁剂都可以用，但是对于液体的没有一个类似量杯的功能有点遗憾

Sentence (English): Bottom Line - Dishwasher did not work out of the box and am very disappointed with the Kitchen Aid Customer service experience.
Comments (English): [ Very Disappointed ] || ---------------- || Bottom Line - Dishwasher did not work out of the box and am very disappointed with the Kitchen Aid Customer service experience. Purchased this dishwasher in April 2023 in preparation for our upcoming kitchen renovation. Chose Kitchen Aid based on reviews and quality reputation. Installed the unit in early August 2023. Unit did not work when I attempted to run it and threw "7-2" error code indicating a motor failure per the owner's manual. I contacted the Kitchen Aid Customer service line and was informed the "7-2" error code did not appear in their list. The customer service representative booked a service appointment to evaluate the dishwasher. This appointment was set for over a week after the problem was identified. Upon arrival, the service tech (3rd party company) determined the dishwasher was throwing a 7-2 error code requiring the motor be replaced. No further troubleshooting or repairs were conducted. The tech ordered parts and booked a follow-on appointment. The 3rd party company used by Kitchen Aid to service warranty claims does not provide appointment times until the day prior to scheduled service with no guarantee of morning, afternoon, etc. I have rescheduled this appointment (for warranty service) three times due to this scheduling policy. It will likely be greater than one month following initial contact with customer service until a warranty repair is attempted. While the 3rd party company's scheduling policy is not a Kitchen Aid problem, this is the company contracted to conduct their warranty work and the service experience is inferior to that of Kitchen aid competitors. Rated 2 stars as the dishwasher looks great and I have not been able to evaluate actual dishwasher performance.

Sentence (English): Bottom Line - Dishwasher did not work out of the box and am very disappointed with the Kitchen Aid Customer service experience.
Comments (English): [ Very Disappointed ] || ---------------- || Bottom Line - Dishwasher did not work out of the box and am very disappointed with the Kitchen Aid Customer service experience.Purchased this dishwasher in April 2023 in preparation for our upcoming kitchen renovation. Chose Kitchen Aid based on reviews and quality reputation. Installed the unit in early August 2023. Unit did not work when I attempted to run it and threw "7-2" error code indicating a motor failure per the owner's manual. I contacted the Kitchen Aid Customer service line and was informed the "7-2" error code did not appear in their list. The customer service representative booked a service appointment to evaluate the dishwasher. This appointment was set for over a week after the problem was identified. Upon arrival, the service tech (3rd party company) determined the dishwasher was throwing a 7-2 error code requiring the motor be replaced. No further troubleshooting or repairs were conducted. The tech ordered parts and booked a follow-on appointment. The 3rd party company used by Kitchen Aid to service warranty claims does not provide appointment times until the day prior to scheduled service with no guarantee of morning, afternoon, etc. I have rescheduled this appointment (for warranty service) three times due to this scheduling policy. It will likely be greater than one month following initial contact with customer service until a warranty repair is attempted. While the 3rd party company's scheduling policy is not a Kitchen Aid problem, this is the company contracted to conduct their warranty work and the service experience is inferior to that of Kitchen aid competitors.Rated 2 stars as the dishwasher looks great and I have not been able to evaluate actual dishwasher performance.

Sentence (English): Since it is a non-installation product, it has many disadvantages compared to a regular dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ It's hard to recommend ] || ---------------- || Since it is a non-installation product, it has many disadvantages compared to a regular dishwasher. Since the cleaning power itself is the same as a regular dishwasher, there is no big difference. However, since there is no function such as pre-washing and it is always washed with detergent and then rinsed, if there are large lumps or a lot of oil on the dishes, you need to wipe them with a paper towel or water before putting them in the dishwasher. Since it is inevitably small, you can only put in very small pots and frying pans, and you have to use it mainly for dishes, plates, and spoons. A dishwasher is only meaningful if it reduces dishwashing time, but since you have to wash pots and frying pans by hand anyway, it is less useful than a regular installation product. However, it does reduce the effort of washing dishes, small bowls, and spoons, and since you can put in small pots or small air fryer baskets, it is not useless. Only those who do not have any space to install a regular dishwasher should buy a non-installation product, and it is better to use a regular installation product if possible. I had a water leak when I first used it. The water level sensor was not working properly, so the product was overfilled with water, and the water that exceeded the capacity was not safely drained, but flowed out the bottom and sides of the product. The same problem has not occurred since the first time, but since the product is not made to safely drain water when it overflows, never use it with an automatic water supply, and you need to use it in a safe place to avoid problems when leakage occurs. I am using it on a stainless steel sink.

It's also quieter than a massage chair, so I think I can use it late at night. The kitchen-fit design adds a nice touch to my home. In our case, we had to cut about 9cm off the mop holder, which was included in the dishwasher cost, so it was done free of charge. Three-tier storage + space-saving. It's divided into three sections: bottom, middle, and multi-purpose baskets, making it more convenient than the previous two-tier system. The bottom section can comfortably accommodate pots and pans. The middle section is height-adjustable (with a lever), allowing for ample storage. It can accommodate plates and bowls of various heights. The top section allows for tongs and utensils to be stored at the top, which previously required interspersing between the shelves. This space-saving feature allows for a large amount of storage at once. The door opens automatically. The default time was about 1 hour and 55 minutes, so I thought it would run for way too long. Actually, it runs for about 1 hour and 20 minutes, and when there's about 30 minutes left, it switches to the final rinse cycle. Think of it as a drying function that opens the door. My previous dishwasher didn't have an automatic door opening, so I had to open it manually after use. It smelled and was stuffy, so I sometimes had to rinse it again. Now, the automatic door opening solves that problem. It's great. It also minimizes vibration and noise. My previous dishwasher was so noisy late at night that I felt bad about running it. The first time I used the Samsung dishwasher, I thought, "Oh? Is it not running?" It was so quiet that I put it on pause. I opened it. The service was excellent. The remodeling technician and the installer were both incredibly friendly and helpful. As expected from Samsung, everything from the phone call to the post-installation instructions was thorough. They recommended using either solid or powdered detergent. I guess the liquid version creates a lot of foam and tends to spill. The dishwasher claims that it can be used about three times after refilling the rinse aid. They also recommend using rinse aid to remove water stains. (Never use regular dishwashing detergent.) Overall, after about 10 years in my parents' house, the appliances started breaking down one by one. The door of the built-in dishwasher was broken. I asked for repairs, and they said that parts in built-in dishwashers that are older than a certain number of years are sometimes beyond repair, so I was using it with the door broken. One of the great things about modern appliances is that the automatic door opens, which dries dishes thoroughly, making them clean and convenient for the next use. It's also quieter than a massage chair, so I think I can use it late at night. The kitchen-fit design adds a nice touch to my home. I was a little worried about the pink color, but it brightened up the kitchen, and after about 10 years, I was considering remodeling, so I plan to keep using it for a while. The Samsung technicians were incredibly friendly and gave thorough explanations. This is a review I wrote after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

My previous dishwasher didn't have an automatic door opening, so I had to open it manually after use. It smelled and was stuffy, so I sometimes had to rinse it again. Now, the automatic door opening solves that problem. It's great. It also minimizes vibration and noise. My previous dishwasher was so noisy late at night that I felt bad about running it. The middle section is height-adjustable (with a lever), allowing for ample storage. It can accommodate plates and bowls of various heights. The top section allows for tongs and utensils to be stored at the top, which previously required interspersing between the shelves. This space-saving feature allows for a large amount of storage at once. The door opens automatically. The default time was about 1 hour and 55 minutes, so I thought it would run for way too long. Actually, it runs for about 1 hour and 20 minutes, and when there's about 30 minutes left, it switches to the final rinse cycle. Think of it as a drying function that opens the door. My previous dishwasher didn't have an automatic door opening, so I had to open it manually after use. It smelled and was stuffy, so I sometimes had to rinse it again. Now, the automatic door opening solves that problem. It's great. It also minimizes vibration and noise. My previous dishwasher was so noisy late at night that I felt bad about running it. One of the great things about modern appliances is that the automatic door opens, which dries dishes thoroughly, making them clean and convenient for the next use. It's also quieter than a massage chair, so I think I can use it late at night. The kitchen-fit design adds a nice touch to my home. I was a little worried about the pink color, but it brightened up the kitchen, and after about 10 years, I was considering remodeling, so I plan to keep using it for a while. Sentence (English): I've been wanting a Bosch 800 series dishwasher for many years now, but I was also waiting for my current machine to bite the dust.
Comments (English): [ Exceptional Bosch performance ] || ---------------- || I've been wanting a Bosch 800 series dishwasher for many years now, but I was also waiting for my current machine to bite the dust. When the old one finally wasn't even washing dishes anymore, I redid my research and determined that the 800 series was still the dishwasher for me. It's so quiet that I really do have to look at the red light shining on the floor to make sure it's on. The stainless steel tub is great, and the racks seem well made. They slide easily, and there's lots of space in the bottom rack when you remove the silverware basket. I can fit way more plates on the bottom rack than I could with my old dishwasher. Some people might be annoyed with the 3rd rack on top for cutlery, small items, etc., but I like it. I find it much easier to open the door a little and put a dirty utensil on that rather than opening the whole dishwasher and pulling out the bottom rack just to put a dirty spoon or fork in the basket. That might seem trivial, but it's something I notice. And most importantly, it gets dishes clean! We run it once a day for our family of 7, and everything comes out clean using normal and crystal dry. Yes there can be some water sitting in cracks and crevices of plastic ware, but I don't expect perfection from any appliance. All in all, I'm pleased with this dishwasher and I would purchase it again.

Sentence (English): We replaced an older model Maytag with this Bosch 300 dishwasher and we are beyond thrilled.
Comments (English): [ Fantastic Machine and Delivery Service! ] || ---------------- || We replaced an older model Maytag with this Bosch 300 dishwasher and we are beyond thrilled. Let me start with the Costco delivery experience. They said they'd deliver on Thursday. They called Wednesday to confirm the delivery window would be between 8:00 and 10:00 am. They showed up at 8:15 after calling to say that they were on the way. They had to make a minor adjustment for the installation, they did a very clean job, installation kit was included, they removed the old unit, cleaned up after themselves and were out of here by about 9:10. And both guys were very pleasant. OK, now to the unit. The unit comes with a simple tester to check for water hardness/softness. Ours is just slightly on the hard side, so I added dishwasher salt to the reservoir, did a simple setting per the instructions and it now automatically dispenses a small amount to each wash to aid in drying, rinsing and adds to the longevity of the machine. The 3 rack system offers a variety of loading choices. We have decided not to use the silverware basket, but to load the silver on the top rack. We have run each load on the “Normal” cycle and the dishes come out sparkling clean and dry. Plastic Tupperware was slightly damp, so on the next loads we hit the extra dry cycle, which is 10 minutes longer and it helps with the damp plastic, though some might fuss about it still having a tiny drop, or so. It's a non-factor to me. It's so quiet that I had to put my ear up to it to be sure that it was working. So, after taking the time to read the manual thoroughly and setting things up as directed, my initial rating is 5 stars with no reservations. One other thing. The unit went on sale right after we got it installed . I contacted Costco on line and we were promptly credited the difference!

I loved being able to turn off the heated dry on any cycle. The other is that in the center of the bottom rack the spindles are spaced so far apart that it can't be used for stacking dishes vertically. Some of the spindles in other areas have an option for being folded down and it would be great to have that in the bottom rack.

Comments (English): [ Good product, horrible business installation syste ] || ---------------- || This review has been waiting a long time and I'm giving it three stars on the whole. The washer itself, we give it 5 stars. I'll explain. My wife and I bought a Samsung three rack dishwasher with the panel controls in the front. This occurred during the 2022 black Fri sale. In general, we love our washer. We are ones to do insurance options on a selective amount of electrics and appliances. So, we got the insurance plus the installer fee only bc if the unit was installed incorrectly, all insurance possibilities would have been void. Kind of stupid and steep price, but we wanted this unit to last. Plus, we also decided to get the \"installation kit\" from them. Well, this was a crazy experience. We have come to learn that Best buy's computer systems do not communicate at all with their installer vendors or, at the least, have huge problems/glitches in the system to where orders are not being transmitted properly. You would think that the company, the millions if not billions of $ in profit, this shouldn't be an issue. Or perhaps it was the system from the vendor. They may have updated/ fixed the problem by now …maybe…. bc I'm just now reporting my review in August and this happened at the end of November of 2022 and finished in January 2023. Was supposed to be installed in December 2022. Another thing to add is that, ironically enough, the teams they also had in hand were out sick with COVID, as they claim, from a recent install. Why you would need all your crews at one place is beyond me. The process of getting the unit was a huge pain. Lots of patience was needed in order to get through it. If best buy had not gifted us a gift card and a certain sum of a refund for such issues and inconveniences they would have had a single star if at all. But, again, we worked together in the end and got the washer. Honestly, I don't know if I'll ever go that route again. Just glad that the insurance that they offer applys differently to their tvs bc we get ours there. And the insurance policy is reasonable. I won't go there bc it doesn't apply the same.

Sentence (English): Our Whirlpool dishwasher lasted nearly 20 years, so we did not hesitate to stick with Whirlpool when it finally came time to replace it.
Comments (English): [ Cheap, Nasty Unit ] || ---------------- || Our Whirlpool dishwasher lasted nearly 20 years, so we did not hesitate to stick with Whirlpool when it finally came time to replace it. But, alas, things have changed over those 20 years. This model is real cheap and nasty. The door is off-center by about 1/4" and does not even clear the dishwasher body on one side (I did not see in the manual any reference on if there is an adjustment for this). How on earth this leaves the factory like this I have no idea. The door squeaks on opening and closing and although there is adjustment for the door tension, options seem to have the door fall open (but not squeak), or have the door with the right tension but squeak. The frame in which the adjusting legs are inserted looks to come from a Meccano set (sorry to embarrass Spin Master here). One side was already bent when the unit was removed from the box. Nearly all plastic construction; the unit looks like it is intended to be disposable. There is no need to waste a few hundred dollars on a unit this nasty. May as well just by one of those cheap Asian brands that could not possibly be any worse. If you do want a good dishwasher, you'll need to spend much more and probably look to Bosch or other European brands. Manufacturing is now clearly beyond our capability.

Sentence (English): Overall, I cannot say enough nice things about this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Bosch 500 Series ] || ---------------- || Overall, I cannot say enough nice things about this dishwasher. It replaced a dishwasher that was 15 years old and on it's last leg. I have been using my new Bosch dishwasher for the last 4 months. I love the look of the dishwasher. It is very sleek with the pocket handle and the controls on the top of the door. It is extremely quiet. At first, I thought it wasn't quiet enough to warrant the light on the floor so I turned the light off. Then I realized that without the light I didn't always know when it was running. So even though it isn't totally silent, it is really quiet and the indicator lets me know it is running. When using my old dishwasher, I had to wash every dish before putting it in the dishwasher. With my new Bosch, I scrape my dishes, put them in the dishwasher, choose the appropriate cycle and they come out super clean. Since it is so energy efficient, I don't worry about waiting until the dishwasher is completely full to run it. Now I run it when it is close to full. I thought I would use the third shelf for silverware but I mainly use it for the Tupperware lids which I love that they fit nicely regardless of the size. I wasn't quite sure about the silverware holder in the first rack since you have to put each individual piece of silverware in separately. But I like that the silverware doesn't nest inside the other silverware and although it is a little bit more of a hassle, I know that that each piece will come out clean. The indicator light for the rinse aid is a game changer. Now I don't have to try to figure out if the clear liquid has reached the fill line. The indicator light lets me know when to add more and it goes out when there is enough in the machine. I would still like there to be a better way to know if the rinse aid is full, but that is way down on my list of necessities for a dishwasher. I looked at the upgraded models but decided this one had all of the features I needed. For me, the time saved was well worth the extra expense to buy this appliance. I would definitely buy it again!

It is extremely quiet.  At first, I thought it wasn't quiet enough to warrant the light on the floor so I turned the light off.  Then I realized that without the light I didn't always know when it was running.  So even though it isn't totally silent, it is really quiet and the indicator lets me know it is running.  When using my old dishwasher, I had to wash every dish before putting it in the dishwasher.  With my new Bosch, I scrape my dishes, put them in the dishwasher, choose the appropriate cycle and they come out super clean.  Since it is so energy efficient, I don't worry about waiting until the dishwasher is completely full to run it.  Now I run it when it is close to full.  I thought I would use the third shelf for silverware but I mainly use it for the Tupperware lids which I love that they fit nicely regardless of the size.  I wasn't quite sure about the silverware holder in the first rack since you have to put each individual piece of silverware in separately.  But I like that the silverware doesn't nest inside the other silverware and although it is a little bit more of a hassle, I know that that each piece will come out clean.  The indicator light for the rinse aid is a game changer.  Now I don’t have to try to figure out if the clear liquid has reached the fill line.  The indicator light lets me know when to add more and it goes out when there is enough in the machine.  I would still like there to be a better way to know if the rinse aid is full, but that is way down on my list of necessities for a dishwasher. I looked at the upgraded models but decided this one had all of the features I needed.  For me, the time saved was well worth the extra expense to buy this appliance.  I would definitely buy it again!

Sentence (English): We bought this about a month ago and are very happy with it.
Comments (English): [ Love it ] || ---------------- || We bought this about a month ago and are very happy with it. It cleans dishes well, and they come out dry. The racks roll well, and the middle rack is easy to adjust up and down. The three racks provide ample space for items. Previously, our dishwasher only had the typical 2 racks. Here are some differences I've noticed: 1) You have to bend over a little more to load the middle/lower racks. This is how they fit the 3rd top rack in. 2) We use a lot of quart mason jars which I put in the middle rack (they're tall). This has meant that the spacing between the middle and lowest rack is a little smaller than when there were just 2 racks like we had before. So my fry plans don't fit as well as before. Personally, I would rather fit all of my smaller dishes in and hand wash a few big items, so this is not a deal breaker for me. Pans would fit better if I didn't need the height for the jars in the middle rack. The buttons are very easy to push/lean against with your leg when unloading the dishwasher, but it hasn't been a big deal since it just cancels if not started. Or it's easy to press cancel when you close it up if needed. The only thing I've noticed that I wish were different is that the slots for the silverware alternate rows with smaller slots and then larger slots. Our silverware will only fit in the larger slots, so half of the spaces go unused. I took off the lid on one side of the silverware holder, and that lets us fit in bigger spatula/serving spoons as well as any extra silverware. Overall, this is a great machine. It does the job well, the stainless steel interior is awesome, and it runs very quiet. I especially love that it has a self-cleaning filter.

Sentence (English): We bought this about a month ago and are very happy with it.
Comments (English): [ Love it ] || ---------------- || We bought this about a month ago and are very happy with it. It cleans dishes well, and they come out dry. The racks roll well, and the middle rack is easy to adjust up and down. The three racks provide ample space for items. Previously, our dishwasher only had the typical 2 racks. Here are some differences I've noticed: 1) You have to bend over a little more to load the middle/lower racks. This is how they fit the 3rd top rack in. 2) We use a lot of quart mason jars which I put in the middle rack (they're tall). This has meant that the spacing between the middle and lowest rack is a little smaller than when there were just 2 racks like we had before. So my fry plans don't fit as well as before. Personally, I would rather fit all of my smaller dishes in and hand wash a few big items, so this is not a deal breaker for me. Pans would fit better if I didn't need the height for the jars in the middle rack. The buttons are very easy to push/lean against with your leg when unloading the dishwasher, but it hasn't been a big deal since it just cancels if not started. Or it's easy to press cancel when you close it up if needed.The only thing I've noticed that I wish were different is that the slots for the silverware alternate rows with smaller slots and then larger slots. Our silverware will only fit in the larger slots, so half of the spaces go unused. I took off the lid on one side of the silverware holder, and that lets us fit in bigger spatula/serving spoons as well as any extra silverware. Overall, this is a great machine. It does the job well, the stainless steel interior is awesome, and it runs very quiet. I especially love that it has a self-cleaning filter.

Sentence (English): The unit functions very well, but the poor rack design makes using it extremely frustrating.
Comments (English): [ Terrible rack designs ] || ---------------- || The unit functions very well, but the poor rack design makes using it extremely frustrating. The lower rack has a 22" Front-Back dimension, but the row spacing doesn't allow 2 10" plates side by side. Instead, it will only allow a 10" plate and a 9" plate to fit and then has wasted space at the front that nothing but long knives can use. The upper rack is no better. It's designed with what looks to be 5 rows front to back. It may be only 3 rows since rows 2 and 4 are wasted spaces where nothing fits. The center row looks to be ideal for saucers, but can't be used for them because of a poorly placed wire directly in the middle of the row. This wire forces the saucers to roll out and bump into adjacent dishes. Many more dishes could have been loaded if there were only 4 rows. '

Sentence (English): Good things to know when making doors!
Comments (English): [ Good things to know when making doors! I installed it under the gas stove. ] || ---------------- || Good things to know when making doors! I installed it under the gas stove. Originally, I was going to install the gas stove and the dishwasher close to each other, but due to the gas pipes, if I installed the dishwasher so close to each other, the gas stove would float upwards, so I installed it with a little space. So the door I made came down slightly. I think it would be helpful to ask the driver about this in advance. Everyone, please take note! Oh, and please check the door immediately when delivery arrives. The corner of the door was slightly crushed during delivery, but I checked it later when installing it and decided to just use it. Installation process. 1. Order a dishwasher. 2. The driver will contact you 1 day before the desired delivery date. (At this time, the technician is not a dishwasher installer, but a partner company technician who manufactures the sink door.) . 3. When the technician visits, he will measure the size of the dishwasher installation site and cut the mop plate to the appropriate size. At this time, you can also select the lower cabinet color and handle color. Depending on the installation situation, it can be used without a handle, but in my house, a handle must be installed, so I installed it. Sometimes, in homes with babies, babies can get hurt by the handle. They say there are situations that must be avoided. Since we don't have a baby yet, we just put a handle on it. 4. The doors and handles ordered by our partner driver will be delivered in 3-4 days. 5. I received a call from the installer at a similar time. At this time, we coordinated the schedule with the driver and installed the dishwasher. Just attach the door and handle and the installation is complete! The installer very kindly taught me how to use it and also adjusted the gap in the lower cabinet door next to the dishwasher, so I was very satisfied with the installation. I like it very much!
Comments (Original): [ 문 제작시 알아두면 좋은점!저는 가스렌지 아래에 설치 ... ] || ---------------- || 문 제작시 알아두면 좋은점!저는 가스렌지 아래에 설치 했는데요. 원래는 가스렌지와 식세기를 바짝 위아래 붙여서 설치하려고 했는데 가스배관 때문에  바짝 붙여서 식세기를 설치하면 가스렌지가 위로 떠서  약간의 공간을 띄우고 설치했어요. 그래서 제작한 문이 아래로 약간 내려오게 되었어요. 미리 기사님께 이점 물어보시면 도움될거 같아요. 다들 참고하셔요!! 아 그리고 배송 오면 바로 문 확인해보셔요. 저는 배송 오는 중에 문 모서리가 약간 뭉겨져서 왔는데 뒤늦게 설치할때 확인해서 그냥 쓰기로 했어요.설치 과정 1.식세기를 주문한다. 2.배송 희망일 1일전 기사님께 연락이 옵니다. (이때 기사님은 식세기 설치기사님이 아닌 씽크대 도어 제작해 주시는 협력사 기사님입니다.)3.기사님 방문하시면 식세기 설치 자리 사이즈 측정 및 걸레 받이를 알맞은 크기로 절단해주십니다.   하부장 컬러 + 손잡이 컬러 선택도 이때 합니다. ※설치 상황에 따라 손잡이를 달지 않고도 사용할수 있으나, 저희집은 손잡이를 꼭 설치해야하는 조건이라 설치하게 되었어요.  간혹 아기 있는 집에서는 손잡이에 아기들이 다칠수 있어서 꼭 피해야하는 상황이 있다고 하더라고요. 저희는 아직 아기가 없기에 그냥 손잡이 달았어요.4.협력사 기사님이 주문해주신 문과 손잡이가 3-4일뒤 배송옵니다.5.설치기사님께 비슷한 시점에 연락이 오는데요 . 이때 기사님과 일정 조율 해서 식세기 설치하고문+손잡이 달면 설치 끝!!설치 기사님께서 너무 친절하게 사용법도 알려주시고 식세기 옆 하부장 문에 단차가 생긴것도 같이 조절해주셔서 너무 만족스럽게 설치 되었어요~ 아주아주 마음에 듭니다!!

Sentence (English): I've had my 800 series Bosch DW for about 4 months now.
Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I've had my 800 series Bosch DW for about 4 months now. My previous DW was also a Bosch and was 20 years old and still working when I decided to upgrade. I never considered any other brand but Bosch. However I only got the 800 series because the 500 was not available at the time. I don't find the extra features really necessary; I rarely use the Crystal Dry feature. I'm not crazy about the newer utensil baskets, separating each piece of silverware as it takes more effort to load. And I had to relearn how to load the bottom rack as it seems a bit different than my old one. I didn't think I would like the skinny top rack but have found it useful for small items. As with my old Bosch I rarely use anything but the basic wash cycle. I find that the new DW is just a tad less quiet than the old one. I do like the quieter end of cycle signal too. This one only beeps a couple of times. The old one went on for hours. All in all I am very happy with my new Bosch DW. It's well built, quiet and does a great job! I hope to get many years out of this Bosch DW as well! I highly recommend Bosch dishwashers.

Sentence (English): To start, you will not receive the same machine in the photos.
Comments (English): [ Worst purchase I've ever made ] || ---------------- || To start, you will not receive the same machine in the photos. The outside looks the same, but the inside is totally different than what is advertised.Second, this is the lightest, cheapest feeling dishwasher I have ever experienced. The racks feel about as heavy as an empty soda can. Everything is plastic, including the flimsy latch (that doesn't latch properly).The door: it opens and closes, but it doesn't stay closed because the latch only catches SOME of the time. And why? Because the flimsy door also moves SIDE TO SIDE. And not slightly either, I'm talking inches of wiggle room to the left and right. It's like the door wasn't even attached all the way and it just moves around in every direction. The final nail in the coffin is that it doesn't even work. We get the door closed after several attempts, the door finally latches, we hear a click, we select a mode and start the machine. And nothing. No water filling up, no sound or movement at all. Just a stupid orange light flashing.Check the other negative reviews. Mine is not the only one with complaints about the door, the latch, the inside being different, the cheap quality of the whole thing.Even if this thing worked, it's so cheap and flimsy that there is no way it will last. I can't believe this piece of junk is being sold anywhere, and REALLY can't believe they want $400 for it. I wouldn't pay $20 for this thing.Lowes only gives you 48 hours to return it, but fortunately I can't get this piece of crap out of my house fast enough. I will not buy another GE appliance and will not trust Lowes again to provide quality merchandise.

We owned our last dishwasher, a Maytag, for about 12 years, and had to have it serviced three times during our ownership. Last month, when a part randomly fell off of the door, we decided it was time for a new machine. Our other kitchen appliances are Whirlpool, so this is the brand we started looking into. Unbeknownst to us, dishwashers have come a ways in a dozen years. We love the third rack, and the adjustable top rack. It is so nice to group spoons, forks etc together, then when washed just grab the whole sections and put in the silverware drawer. I like that the silverware is up higher too. The cons are still outweighed by the fact that it cleans so well and is so quiet. Love that!

Sentence (English): Other than the fact that I have to dry half the dishes no matter what settings I use, it is a decent dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Dishes do not come out dry ] || ---------------- || Other than the fact that I have to dry half the dishes no matter what settings I use, it is a decent dishwasher. I now am having to make sure to dry almost all the dishes as I put them away. This was not the case with my old dishwasher, so this is an unwelcome addition to my routine. I have checked the settings - the D1 option to make sure you have dry cycle selected, the rinse aid to improve spottiness, and the heated dry AND sanitize options set with every cycle. Still I have to dry the dishes by hand. I called customer support and they said they didn't want me to have to dry the dishes by hand and I agreed with them but there doesn't seem to be any other option. Support mentioned that if I had bought the 500 series it would come with a feature that causes it to pop itself open when the cycle is complete, which they claim will help with the drying. His suggestion was maybe I can pop the dishwasher open at the end of the cycle. As I run it before bed, this is not going to happen. Other than the wet dishes at the end of the cycle, it works okay. But I was hoping for more than OK for this price and this brand.

Sentence (English): We purchased this dishwasher and took delivery on 07/29/23.
Comments (English): We purchased this dishwasher and took delivery on 07/29/23. We were able to run a total of two loads before the electronics went kaput; we had to turn the circuit it's on off at the breaker box in order to make it stop making ongoing sounds reminiscent of a casino. When the first of what is now three (3) repair appointments occurred, the diagnostics showed we'd run 15 cycles. After this appointment, we were able to run an almost-cycle before the same thing happened; again to the breaker box we went (after 1am, mind you). At appointment two, the diagnostics showed more than 20 cycles had run. Parts were ordered, and our 3rd repair appointment was scheduled for today; the person cancelled. IOW, we've “owned” this machine for nearly a month and have been able to use it twice. The irony is this unit is the replacement for it's sightly more expensive relative whose electronics also went out within the first five years.

We were able to run a total of two loads before the electronics went kaput; we had to turn the circuit it's on off at the breaker box in order to make it stop making ongoing sounds reminiscent of a casino. When the first of what is now three (3) repair appointments occurred, the diagnostics showed we'd run 15 cycles. After this appointment, we were able to run an almost-cycle before the same thing happened; again to the breaker box we went (after 1am, mind you). At appointment two, the diagnostics showed more than 20 cycles had run. Parts were ordered, and our 3rd repair appointment was scheduled for today; the person cancelled. IOW, we've “owned” this machine for nearly a month and have been able to use it twice. The irony is this unit is the replacement for it's sightly more expensive relative whose electronics also went out within the first five years.

Just saying does not dry dishes or has adequate racks for various sized glasses cups and dishes like other dishwashers.

Sentence (English): It has been a few months since I bought it, and I have tried to wash a small amount of pots and pans.
Comments (English): It has been a few months since I bought it, and I have tried to wash a small amount of pots and pans. The washing is still clean, but the drying effect is not as good as expected, and it is not dry. If only the standard washing program is used, and there is no special additional disinfection and drying program, there will be a lot of water droplets when the door is opened (as shown in Figure 4 and 5). This makes it easy to have a peculiar smell inside the machine. If the door is not opened for a few days, it will smell a little inside. The machine can be connected to WiFi to remotely control and observe the working status through the mobile phone. But this machine only supports 2.4G WiFi, not 5G WiFi, (as shown in Figure 6). After-sales service: After the installer removes the top cover of the machine, the side will be deformed when dragging the machine, which is caused by the lack of internal reinforcement ribs in the shell design. In this way, although the embedded side cannot be seen to be deformed, if it is replaced by an independent installation in the future, the appearance will not look good (as shown in Figures 1 and 2, the side panel has been deformed near the top). During the installation process, the installer added a "pre-filter" to the water inlet without my consent at first. This so-called "filter" is only the size of an egg (as shown in Figure 3), and it will have no effect, it will only block the water flow, and there will be an additional charge. Fortunately, I found it myself before finishing the work and asked the master to remove it. It is recommended that you pay close attention to the installation, not to be too laissez-faire, you have to keep an eye on it.
Comments (Original): 买来几个月了，尝试过洗少量的锅碗。洗得还算是干净的，就是烘干效果不及预期，干不透。只用标准洗程序，没有专门开附加的消毒烘干程序的话，打开机门是有很多水珠的（如图4和5）。这导致机器内容易出现异味，几天不开门的话，里面就有点臭味。机器可以连接WiFi通过手机远程控制和观察工作状态。但是这机器只支持2.4G的WiFi，不支持5GWiFi，（如图6）。售后服务：安装师傅拆掉机顶盖之后，拖动机器的时候会导致侧边变形，这是外壳设计上内部缺少加强筋所致。这样一来，嵌入式虽然看不到侧边变形，但以后如果要换成独立安装，外观露出来就不好看了（如图1和2，侧板靠近顶部已经变形）。安装师傅在安装过程中，最初没有经过我同意，私自在进水管加入了一个“前置过滤器”。这所谓“过滤器”才鸡蛋大小（如图3），不会有什么作用，只会阻碍水流，还要另外收费。好在我在完工前自己发现了，要求师傅取掉了。建议大家在安装的时候密切注意，不能太放任，自己得盯着。

Sentence (English): We purchased this washer back in July from Costco.
Comments (English): [ LG LDFN4542S Dish Washer ] || ---------------- || We purchased this washer back in July from Costco.Com to replace and upgrade our machine that was about eleven years old. A few days after ordering this washer our old unit had the handle break, so it was really time to upgrade. The Costco ordering process was really simple and included delivery and install and haul away the old unit. The price was really good. The washer is working very well and is much more quiet than the old one. It also cleans better and seems to use less energy. The only problem we have found is the hardware basket is very large and takes up a lot of space and we do not have enough to fill it. The lower rack also does not seem to have enough space for large pots especially with the hardware rack in place. So we have to take that out to wash a large pot. So, all in all it was a really good improvement to our kitchen and we are very happy with the LG Washer. We also have a LG Gas Range that we purchased about seven years ago and it is really good also.

Sentence (English): I'm not normally one to get all excited over a dishwasher, but I have to admit that this is by far the best one that I've ever owned.
Comments (English): [ Best dishwasher I've ever had ] || ---------------- || I'm not normally one to get all excited over a dishwasher, but I have to admit that this is by far the best one that I've ever owned. The features, cleaning and drying power and the functionality of it, makes this dishwasher better than any of the others I've used. Installation was pretty standard with the exception of the need to use a junction box if you dont have an outlet installed where this will be used. The box is normally sold separately for about $20. This dishwasher, even for installation purposes was well thought out. I really like that instead of having to use a flat head screwdriver or a wrench to level the feet, all you need is a screwdriver that adjusts the unit by turning it. The photos show the area at the bottom of the front of the dishwasher where the adjustments are made. This little feature saves time and the difficulty of leveling the unit. The top two racks have height adjustments that aid in loading different items onto those two racks. I also really like the top rack that is ideal for silverware. It take a little more time to load my spoons, forks and knives but my utensils have never been cleaner. There is also the standard removable basket for silverware as well. There are plenty of adjustments to the tines on the bottom two racks that allow flexibility loading dishes of different sizes. One of the best features of this dishwasher is the drying. I've had a Bosch dishwasher before and my biggest issue with it was that the dishes still had water on them after the drying cycle. It was kind of annoying, but at least the dishes were clean. The Crystal Dry feature all but eliminates that problem. My dishes are pretty much bone dry with the exception of cups or glassware that still catches water on the bottom of them, but I dont think any dishwasher can solve that problem. The heating element is located in the rear corner of the dishwasher and combined with the metal interior creates a superior drying experience. I couldnt really be happier with it.Where this dishwasher really shines is that it is a smart device. After downloading the app and connecting it to my Wifi, I can start, stop, program, adjust cleaning settings and be alerted to a completed cycle. So now instead of asking my kids if they ran the dishwasher, I can check for myself and start it if necessary. Within the app, i can adjust the washing intensity by customizing the bottom rack from heavy, normal or light cleaning. I can also program it to start at a certain time each day or cancel that scheduled time if I need to. It also alerts me when I need to add rinse aid to it which is also a great feature that helps to get cleaner dishes. This thing is super, super quiet. It's really difficult to tell when its running, even when I'm standing right next to it. It does have a light on the front of it that is lit when its running so that is helpful. All in all, this is the best dishwasher I've used and would highly recommend it.

The features, cleaning and drying power and the functionality of it, makes this dishwasher better than any of the others I've used. Installation was pretty standard with the exception of the need to use a junction box if you dont have an outlet installed where this will be used. The box is normally sold separately for about $20. This dishwasher, even for installation purposes was well thought out. I really like that instead of having to use a flat head screwdriver or a wrench to level the feet, all you need is a screwdriver that adjusts the unit by turning it. The photos show the area at the bottom of the front of the dishwasher where the adjustments are made. This little feature saves time and the difficulty of leveling the unit. The top two racks have height adjustments that aid in loading different items onto those two racks. I also really like the top rack that is ideal for silverware. It take a little more time to load my spoons, forks and knives but my utensils have never been cleaner. There is also the standard removable basket for silverware as well. There are plenty of adjustments to the tines on the bottom two racks that allow flexibility loading dishes of different sizes. One of the best features of this dishwasher is the drying. I've had a Bosch dishwasher before and my biggest issue with it was that the dishes still had water on them after the drying cycle. It was kind of annoying, but at least the dishes were clean. The Crystal Dry feature all but eliminates that problem. My dishes are pretty much bone dry with the exception of cups or glassware that still catches water on the bottom of them, but I dont think any dishwasher can solve that problem. The heating element is located in the rear corner of the dishwasher and combined with the metal interior creates a superior drying experience. I couldnt really be happier with it.Where this dishwasher really shines is that it is a smart device. After downloading the app and connecting it to my Wifi, I can start, stop, program, adjust cleaning settings and be alerted to a completed cycle. So now instead of asking my kids if they ran the dishwasher, I can check for myself and start it if necessary. Within the app, i can adjust the washing intensity by customizing the bottom rack from heavy, normal or light cleaning. I can also program it to start at a certain time each day or cancel that scheduled time if I need to. It also alerts me when I need to add rinse aid to it which is also a great feature that helps to get cleaner dishes. This thing is super, super quiet. It's really difficult to tell when its running, even when I'm standing right next to it. It does have a light on the front of it that is lit when its running so that is helpful. All in all, this is the best dishwasher I've used and would highly recommend it.

Sentence (English): I replaced an 8 year old dishwasher that stopped working.
Comments (English): [ quiet but underwhelming ] || ---------------- || I replaced an 8 year old dishwasher that stopped working. I tried to fix it myself but it was too much, and repairmen told me it wouldn't be worth it to repair. This dishwasher is shockingly quiet, which is nice. While it looks nice, the racks seem flimsier than the ones on my old dishwasher, and the utensil caddy doesn't fit in as securely. We shall see if it stands the test of time. I don't know if that is a problem from the installers or if it's because of the poor quality instructions or hardware provided with the dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I ordered this dishwasher because of consumers report which I have used for decades for there recommendation.
Comments (English): [ I expected more, very pricey ] || ---------------- || I ordered this dishwasher because of consumers report which I have used for decades for there recommendation. When I received it I knew it didn't have any buttons on the front, I couldn't find one of the bosch with buttons on the front in black. I looked at the racks and wondered whats up with this. Now every time I load it I get angry, nothing fits nicely except the plates and med size bowels . I put my coffee mugs on the left like the manual shows, then saucers next to them, but the tines are to close to the cups and they overlap, It even broke one of my favorite coffee mugs. On the other side where the glasses go the one on the front by the door hits the door when it is closed. The water spray arms are plastic Never had any plastic before, I doubt they will last. Why did they put a filter that has to be cleaned? What a hastle , never had one that had to be cleaned. And it smells bad no matter what you do. I have used bleach, vinegar and the tablets and it still smells bad especially if you do a quick rinse. I even had dishes and a cutting board come out with mold that didn't have it when they went in. The bottom rack is very heavy when pulling and pushing it. I had the repair guy come but it is still very hard to pull. The wheels are very small compared to my last dishwasher. The flatware baskets are small and don't fill the space leaving wasted space, I still use my old one since it holds alot more. I would be using my old bottom rack but it did not fit it was to big. Which means it is not as big as my last dishwasher. I do like how quiet it is but I don't know how much longer it will be on without opening it. I wish it had a front button to give the countdown and not a light on the floor. Customer service not as informed as they should be. Cold water comes in without being heated for a long time. Last the water inlet is plastic, what were they thinking, all the water pressure coming in hopefully this won't be a problem. I thought I would get used to it, NO I have not after several months I still get angry every time I have to load it.

Sentence (English): I love this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Awesome unit! ] || ---------------- || I love this dishwasher. It looks great, is quiet and has many features. It weighs about 76 pounds, is 23.75” wide, 33 5/8” tall, is 24 5/8” deep and is made in Korea. Home Depot installed the unit and the installation went easily, with no issues. The unit has 3 legs: 2 in front and one in the middle of the back. If you have to level the unit, you can adjust the 2 front legs using a wrench or your fingers. If you need to adjust the leg in the back, you do so by adjusting a Phillips screwdriver on the head screw at the center of the bottom front panel (is then covered by the panel). The front is very nice and considering its finish, doesn't show fingerprints too badly. The control panel is easy to understand and well lit and operates with a gentle touch. The dishwasher uses only 2.9 gallons per cycle – I know I use more when I hand wash dishes. It has several cleaning modes including: auto, normal, heavy, and turbo. It's handled everything I've put in there so far and some of those dishes/pots/pans have been pretty messy. One unique feature is that it has a “flexible zone option” that allows you to select the intensity of the spray in different zones of the dishwasher (top shelf or bottom shelf). I find that a particularly useful option when I'm putting grungy pots/skillets in the bottom shelf, but my top shelf is only loaded with drinking glasses. There is also a high temp option, an extra dry option, a delay start option, and a night dry option. The night dry options runs a ventilation fan periodically after a cycle ends to prevent the steam inside from settling and keeping the dishes wet. Since I generally run my dishwasher just before going to bed, this works very well for me. The soap dispenser is on the door. The directions say it will hold up to 10 place settings of silverware. I didn't count, but I know it easily holds enough for a family of 4 plus our serving and cooking utensils. The upper rack height limit is 9” and the lower rack height limit is 12.5” but keep in mind that your items don't generally stand absolutely vertical, but lean a little bit, so that 13” platter will still fit. The manual for it is online and (the English version) runs 40 pages. It comes with a 1 year parts and labor warranty, 2 years for the main control board, the stainless steel door liner and the tub. The direct drive motor comes with a 10 year warranty. I can't imagine anyone not being pleased with this dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I've been in my current home for 35 years with the same cabinets.
Comments (English): [ First Impression, first use ] || ---------------- || I've been in my current home for 35 years with the same cabinets. I have installed at least 5 dishwashers in my time here. I have to say this installation was the most difficult, frustrating task. You wonder if the people who design these washer have ever installed one. At least 3 areas of concern. 1) once the dishwasher is fully in place per the instructions, it is impossible to adjust the rear levelers. Now admittedly, I have a floor that was tiled some years after the house was built. The dishwasher has to be set at its lowest to slide in the cabinet and did not require much vertical adjustment, but it did need a tiny bit of leveling. You would need very tiny hand to slip a tool to turn the leveler from the top. In my case a 15/16" slot cut into a 1/8"thick bar would allow one to grab the base of the leveler provided the bar was long enough. 2) the little metal shield that is supposed to cover the wire nut connection is also difficult to install, mostly because there is the ac jumper connection and another harness in the way. Seems to me that the engineers could put these items out of the way where they would not interfere with the ac cover. 3) The diswasher is quieter partly because of the mass of insulation fill-ins near the door hinges on each side and that thick pad behind the kick panel. These chunks of insulation come in a separate package with instructions of how to stuff in there. Unfortunately it tends to squish out and cover the kick panel mounting holes, adding to the level of frustration.OK so now its installed how does it run? I did a wet run to check for leaks. None were detected. BTW, you have to buy a 90deg elbow with a 3/4 FGH fitting on one end to mate to the diswasher. This has a 3/8 compression fitting on the other end so my 3/8 water supply line fit OK. It was not terribly loud during the wet cycle but I had not installed the kick plate and that unruly mass of extra insulation yet. After the final button up, that insulation made a very big difference.Overall quality is much better than the cheaper GE dishwashers out there which are very flimsy. This one feels more solid at the door and has a stainless steel cabinet but underneath it all is where the costs are cut. My gut feel is that this may be a 3 year dishwasher.My last dishwasher was a previously owned B***H that the homeowner was discarding due to a kitchen renovation. I don't know how long that owner had it but it lasted over a decade for me and still runs. Its just seen its age and we wanted something more like the other appliances we have in our kitchen. It was no peach to install either but easier than the GE. Over the years I had to replace a relay on the control board, resolder some broken solder joint and replace the water pump which developed a leak. So it was not without issues but worth the effort to repair rather than replace.So recommend this GE? Maybe, but I need more time with this one before I make that call. But having installed and worked on that other brand for such a long time, I was already having misgivings about this choice. Time will tell.

I have to say this installation was the most difficult, frustrating task. You wonder if the people who design these washer have ever installed one. At least 3 areas of concern. 1) once the dishwasher is fully in place per the instructions, it is impossible to adjust the rear levelers. Now admittedly, I have a floor that was tiled some years after the house was built. The dishwasher has to be set at its lowest to slide in the cabinet and did not require much vertical adjustment, but it did need a tiny bit of leveling. You would need very tiny hand to slip a tool to turn the leveler from the top. In my case a 15/16" slot cut into a 1/8"thick bar would allow one to grab the base of the leveler provided the bar was long enough. 2) the little metal shield that is supposed to cover the wire nut connection is also difficult to install, mostly because there is the ac jumper connection and another harness in the way. Seems to me that the engineers could put these items out of the way where they would not interfere with the ac cover. 3) The diswasher is quieter partly because of the mass of insulation fill-ins near the door hinges on each side and that thick pad behind the kick panel. These chunks of insulation come in a separate package with instructions of how to stuff in there. Unfortunately it tends to squish out and cover the kick panel mounting holes, adding to the level of frustration.OK so now its installed how does it run? I did a wet run to check for leaks. None were detected. BTW, you have to buy a 90deg elbow with a 3/4 FGH fitting on one end to mate to the diswasher. This has a 3/8 compression fitting on the other end so my 3/8 water supply line fit OK. It was not terribly loud during the wet cycle but I had not installed the kick plate and that unruly mass of extra insulation yet. After the final button up, that insulation made a very big difference.Overall quality is much better than the cheaper GE dishwashers out there which are very flimsy. This one feels more solid at the door and has a stainless steel cabinet but underneath it all is where the costs are cut. My gut feel is that this may be a 3 year dishwasher.My last dishwasher was a previously owned B***H that the homeowner was discarding due to a kitchen renovation. I don't know how long that owner had it but it lasted over a decade for me and still runs. Its just seen its age and we wanted something more like the other appliances we have in our kitchen. It was no peach to install either but easier than the GE. Over the years I had to replace a relay on the control board, resolder some broken solder joint and replace the water pump which developed a leak. So it was not without issues but worth the effort to repair rather than replace.So recommend this GE? Maybe, but I need more time with this one before I make that call. But having installed and worked on that other brand for such a long time, I was already having misgivings about this choice. Time will tell.

With small kids who eat frequently, we go through lots of utensils and this really helps organizing and also it helps utensil cleaning.I looks slick - I like the buttons are not too visible.It is much pretty quiet. My friends sometimes get surprised because they didn't know the dishwasher was running. If you run at night, the noise is more obvious. But it's not bad at all. With the old one, we used the delay options for night runs so it will run after we fall asleep deep and I still woke up to the noise occasaionally. We don't do delay anymore and I can hear the nosie but it's not louder thant white noise leaking from my kids' room.I was worried about repairability and I haven't had a chance to experience that department yet and it has been almost full 3 years. This is the best dishwasher I've ever owned so far. This is the first Bosch dishwasher I tried and I'm likely to go for bosch for my next dishwasher, though I don't know when that would be.

Sentence (English): I developed a herniated disc while giving birth and raising my baby.
Comments (English): [ The best home appliance for housewives with herniated discs! ] || ---------------- || I developed a herniated disc while giving birth and raising my baby. Standing, cooking, preparing baby food, and even washing dishes put a lot of strain on my back. The pain was so bad from standing for long periods of time that I was wishing I had a dishwasher. Then, my husband bought me one as a gift. #InstallationReview. I ordered it on Coupang because it said "rocket installation," but I didn't have high expectations. Since it's a built-in product, a technician would have to come, so I thought ordering it today and installing it tomorrow wouldn't be possible. But it was installed right away! I doubted it would be rocket installation, but the technician called the afternoon of the order to confirm the installation and said he'd be back the following morning. He arrived early the next morning and confirmed the installation was possible. I needed to remove one of the existing cabinets, so the demolition crew needed to come back again. I had to make an appointment, so the technician left. I called the demolition team and they said it would be available the same day. Fortunately, the demolition was completed around lunchtime, and the LG technician came back that afternoon to install it. The technician's schedule and the demolition team's schedule worked well together, making it possible. #Capacity and hot air drying function. I chose the 12-seater dishwasher because many people advise buying a larger one. If you're using a built-in dishwasher, a 12-seater is definitely the way to go. Pots and pans take up more space than you might think, so a larger capacity is essential. The price varies depending on whether or not it has a hot air dryer, but I chose one with a hot air dryer. The hot air dryer also has an automatic door-opening feature. If the dryer feature isn't available, you'll have to leave the door open after the dishwasher is finished, which can be inconvenient. If you put the baby to bed or do other chores, the door will automatically open and dry your clothes without you even noticing. This depends on your personal lifestyle. #User Review. I usually use the standard mode, and the dishwasher runs for 1 hour and 54 minutes. It washes for about an hour, and with 54-5 minutes remaining, the door automatically opens and the hot air dryer starts. I cut the Prosh solid detergent in half, and it washes all my dishes, pots, and other items cleanly. I once had an oily problem and used up all of the detergent, but there was still a bit of foam residue left behind. Since then, I've only used half the detergent. Sentence (English): We needed a dishwasher and after reading several reviews of various brands and prices we decided that to get a good one we would have to start in the $600 and up range.
Comments (English): [ Very Pleased With This Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We needed a dishwasher and after reading several reviews of various brands and prices we decided that to get a good one we would have to start in the $600 and up range. The reviews of the Maytag MDB4949SKZ dishwasher were mostly positive. We decided to purchase one and are glad we did. The unit was purchased at Lowe's in Dec. 2022 and I am writing this review in August of 2023. This dishwasher has a stainless steel tub and is very quiet. We always use the Quick and Heated Dry settings and our dishes, silverware and pans come out clean and dry. We do let the dishwasher sit closed to cool down. The only water might be in the lip of a plasticware storage container, but even that is not that much. The only down side was that this model does not come in white, but matching our other kitchen appliances was a secondary consideration. The stainless steel exterior does look nice and cleans easily. We use Cascade Platinum pods and they clean very well. Be sure to save the electrical plug from your old dishwasher, if this is a replacement instillation, because the plug-in is not included and new ones are about $22. We would definitely recommend this dishwasher.

It washed dishes just fine, it was quiet, everything worked properly until it didn't work at all. SO in conclusion, you may get a good one, you may not. I was unlucky and my unit is completely dead. If you like to gamble, this is the appliance for you.

Comments (English): [ Mostly Very Pleased with a few minor Annoyances ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher seems to do a very good job of cleaning and it is very quiet. I would definitely recommend. It also looks great, is very stylish and has a solid feel. Now the annoyances keeping me from giving it a 5-star rating: The middle rack was installed unevenly and I couldn't even pull it out. I struggled with this for some time and finally was able to remove the entire rack and had to put the wheels back into the rail properly. This fixed it, but I expect better quality control for a $1,300 appliance. It comes with a new drain hose but not a power cord. This is ridiculous and infuriating that I have to be nickel and dimed into finding a power cord. By the way it takes a very specific power cord with rings on the end for the connection. I couldn't find one of these anywhere and so had to salvage the old cord from the old dishwasher and manually strip the inulation to make the connection. This added at least an extra hour to my self-installation. Again, I spent $1,300 on a top of the line dishwasher but they can't even include a freaking power cord. Finally the installation instructions are not great. The illustrations are mostly useless and were it not for the video on the website I may not have been able to do this myself.

Sentence (English): My old dishwasher was not too old but was loud.
Comments (English): [ So far so good for 3 years! ] || ---------------- || My old dishwasher was not too old but was loud. I searched for a quiet one and based on many recommendations, I got this one. I can testify that it has been pretty quiet for the past 3 years. It cleans well and dries well - I was not unhappy with my old one but this is working much better. I like the utensil drawer. With small kids who eat frequently, we go through lots of utensils and this really helps organizing and also it helps utensil cleaning. I looks slick - I like the buttons are not too visible. It is much pretty quiet. My friends sometimes get surprised because they didn't know the dishwasher was running. If you run at night, the noise is more obvious. But it's not bad at all. With the old one, we used the delay options for night runs so it will run after we fall asleep deep and I still woke up to the noise occasaionally. We don't do delay anymore and I can hear the nosie but it's not louder thant white noise leaking from my kids' room. I was worried about repairability and I haven't had a chance to experience that department yet and it has been almost full 3 years. This is the best dishwasher I've ever owned so far. This is the first Bosch dishwasher I tried and I'm likely to go for bosch for my next dishwasher, though I don't know when that would be.
